archetypes.name: optional-scope
archetypes.rationale: Optional plan headings affect multiple parser and advisory paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the MAY_UPDATE implementation end to end. Check that optional headings remain included in normal scope extraction but are excluded only from WARN_PLAN_FILES_UNTOUCHED coverage. Pay close attention to duplicate path handling when a path appears under both optional and firm headings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: design-guidance
archetypes.rationale: Drafter and reviewer prose must not upgrade optional work into firm commitments.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the updated /design and plan-review guidance for consistency. Verify that drafter, revise-waterfall, readability, and dispatcher docs all describe MAY_UPDATE as optional scope without changing existing NEW, UPDATED, or REWRITTEN semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
